description: This file implements a generic doubly linked list in C, including functions for creating, modifying, duplicating, searching, and rotating lists, as well as managing list iterators.

classes.name: list
classes.description: A structure representing a doubly linked list, containing pointers to head and tail nodes, length, and function pointers for duplication, freeing, and matching node values.

classes.name: listNode
classes.description: A node in the doubly linked list, containing pointers to previous and next nodes, and a void pointer to its value.

classes.name: listIter
classes.description: An iterator structure for traversing the list in either head-to-tail or tail-to-head direction.

methods.name: listCreate
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new empty list.

methods.name: listEmpty
methods.description: Removes all elements from the list without freeing the list structure itself.

methods.name: listRelease
methods.description: Frees the entire list and its elements.

methods.name: listAddNodeHead
methods.description: Adds a new node with a specified value at the head of the list.

methods.name: listAddNodeTail
methods.description: Adds a new node with a specified value at the tail of the list.

methods.name: listInsertNode
methods.description: Inserts a new node with a specified value before or after a given node.

methods.name: listDelNode
methods.description: Deletes a specified node from the list.

methods.name: listGetIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator for traversing the list in a specified direction.

methods.name: listReleaseIterator
methods.description: Releases memory allocated for a list iterator.

methods.name: listRewind
methods.description: Resets an iterator to the start of the list (head).

methods.name: listRewindTail
methods.description: Resets an iterator to the end of the list (tail).

methods.name: listNext
methods.description: Returns the next node in the list during iteration.

methods.name: listDup
methods.description: Creates a duplicate of the entire list.

methods.name: listSearchKey
methods.description: Searches for a node with a value matching a key.

methods.name: listIndex
methods.description: Retrieves the node at a specific zero-based index, supporting negative indices for reverse order.

methods.name: listRotateTailToHead
methods.description: Moves the tail node to the head of the list.

methods.name: listRotateHeadToTail
methods.description: Moves the head node to the tail of the list.

methods.name: listJoin
methods.description: Concatenates another list to the end of the current list.
